title: arbayeen hai tera mere bhaya husain
body:
Qabre shabbir par nouha zainab ka tha
Ye behen aayi hai uthke dekho zara
Arbayee'n hai tera mere bhaya husain
1. Haye kadiyal jawaa'n, khayi usne sina
Ek kohram tha bain arzo samaa
Qabre akber pe jab aayi sab bibiyaa
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Qasime qastatan haye gul pairahan
Zindagi me hua uska paamaal tan
Haye bewa hui ek shab ki dulhan
<<DIVIDER>>
3. shaamo koofa se jab hum guzaare gaye
Naam le kar waha'n sab pukaare gaye
Kisko aawaz doo'n sab to maare gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Mere bhaya mere dil me armaan tha
Ho badi dhoom se bhai chehlum tera
Koi saaya nahi thi behen ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Raah me har taraf hasrato yaas thi
Kaise batlaau mau har qadam pyaas thi
Sar barahna rahe yaade abbas thi
Ho gayi intehaa' qaide zindaan me
Thi qayamat bapa ek zindaan me
Dafn aabid ne ki lash zindaan me
Aabide qastatan par the ranjo mahan
Touqo zanjeer thi aur aabid ka tan
Sehke sulmo sitam aayi bekas behen
